abstract: The cell biological characteristics of a newly established human gestational choriocarcinoma cell line, HM, were examined and compared with four other gestational and two nongestational choriocarcinoma cell lines. Striking heterogeneity in the production and secretion of hCG and its subunits was observed among the cell lines. The HM cell line consisted mainly of cytotrophoblast-like cells, and the hCG and its subunit values in both the cells and culture fluid were extremely low. The syncytiotrophoblast-like multinucleated giant cells which were occasionally seen in other cell lines were scarce in the HM cell line in vitro. On the other hand, deviation of the LDH isozyme pattern to the heart-type (LDH1) was characteristic of the HM cells in contrast to the other cell lines in which LDH3 was dominant. The HM cell line represents useful material for investigating the cell biological heterogeneity of human choriocarcinomas.
abstract_ja: 新たに樹立したヒト妊娠性絨毛癌細胞株HMの細胞生物学的特性を、4株の妊娠性絨毛癌細胞株および2株の非妊娠性絨毛癌細胞株と比較して検討した。各細胞株間では、hCGおよびそのサブユニットの産生・分泌に顕著な不均一性が認められた。HM細胞株は主に細胞栄養膜様細胞から構成されており、細胞内および培養液中のhCGおよびそのサブユニットの値は極めて低かった。他の細胞株で時折認められた合胞体栄養膜様多核巨細胞は、HM細胞株ではin vitroにおいてわずかしか認められなかった。一方、LDHアイソザイムのパターンは、HM細胞株に特徴的な心筋型(LDH1)へ偏倚していた。他の細胞株ではLDH3が優位であった。HM細胞株は、ヒト絨毛癌の細胞生物学的不均一性を研究するための有用な材料である。
